title: Comparison preserves the constant closed-exchange mate
statement: For a commutative ring A and every commutative square D′ → D, D′ → Z′, D → Z, Z′ → Z of schemes, applying pro-etale inverse image to geoCartierSourceComparison and then geoCartierExchange equals the inverse-image site comparison followed by comparison inverse image of the ordinary supportedConstantExchange and the primed geoCartierSourceComparison [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface]. This is an equality of sheaf maps, requiring no Cartier ideal, Kummer class, positive annihilator or finite coefficients.

proof.text: Apply mateEquiv_counit_symm and iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_symm to the restriction/direct-image square. This identifies inverse image of lowerStarComparisonUpperStarBaseChange followed by the pro-etale counit with comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso followed by comparison of the etale counit. Naturality of the counit adds the constant-sheaf comparison, giving the transpose of geoCartierSourceComparison.

Use the composition clause of comparison_pullback_coherent and cancel the invertible components to put it in the orientation of comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso. Apply this to i prime followed by g and to gD followed by i. Transport along the supplied commutativity equality, and cancel the composition isomorphisms. The result is coherence of these comparisons with geoCartierPullbackSquare and Etale.squareUpperStarIso for the given arbitrary commutative square; no Cartesian hypothesis is used.

Normalize both constant-sheaf comparisons by their defining adjunctions. The forward map of each uniqueness-of-left-adjoint isomorphism is the inverse-image adjunct of the constant-section map. Transpose the two composite maps through the composite inverse-image adjunctions and the canonical direct-image comparison. After applying the sheafification Hom equivalence, both sides send every constant presheaf section to the same section; the direct-image comparison is the identity at each etale object. Injectivity gives compatibility of the canonical constant maps with comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso.

Transpose the desired equality under the pro-etale inverse-image/direct-image adjunction for i prime. Naturality of geoCartierPullbackSquare and the source-counit identity of step 1 rewrite the left transpose. Step 3 moves the constant map through comparison, and step 2 identifies its square path. On the right transpose, use the same source-counit identity for i prime, naturality of the inverse-image comparison, and Etale.upperStar_map_baseChangeMap_app_counit. Both composites coincide by functoriality and associativity. Injectivity of the Hom equivalence proves the stated equality, including empty schemes, identity morphisms and the zero ring.

lean.statement:
theorem geoCartier_closed_exchange_comparison (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {D D' Z Z' : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ Z) (i' : D' ⟶ Z')
    (g : Z' ⟶ Z) (gD : D' ⟶ D) (sq : CommSq gD i' i g) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).map (geoCartierSourceComparison A i) ≫
        geoCartierExchange A i i' g gD sq =
      (comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).hom.app
          ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (Etale.ordinaryFiniteConstant A D)) ≫
        (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z').map
          (Etale.supportedConstantExchange A i i' g gD sq) ≫
        geoCartierSourceComparison A i'
